🇲🇽🌾 <u>Mexico's Rice Harvest Jumps 17.3%</u>

Mexico produced 257,480 tonnes of rice in 2025, up 17.3% from 219,587 in 2024, according to the Agriculture Ministry (Sader). The area planted grew 28.4%, from 31,346 to 40,250 hectares, and the value of the harvest rose 12.5% to 1.463 billion pesos. Nayarit led with 79,737 tonnes, followed by Campeche with 61,670 and Michoacán with 37,300.
